additional_info.subject: Ticket Creation Request – Charging Station Screen Issue
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I would like to create a ticket for an issue reported by Mr. Clémente François from the Utilities department at Procter & Gamble in Blois. For the past two days, the screen of the truck charging station has been completely black.
We have already tried rebooting the charger and resetting the control unit, but the issue persists.
Additional Information:
•     The etruck is still able to charge without using the screen.
•     The local P&G team will be available to assist with the initial diagnostics (such as measuring 24V at the screen’s power source).
Charging station details:
•     Model: Sirache D
•     Serial number: MPPD170001300
•     Contact: Mr. Clémente François (deoliveiraclemen.f@pg.com)
Please address this request as soon as possible.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:
+33 650 370 485

Regarding the issue of HMI black screen problem, Please check the following below:
Check for any loose connections to the screen and board.
Update the Dlogic firmware, if its not done in past.
Check for the 24VDC supply to the Dlogic board(PH2).
Verify if the DP cables have been changed in the past with this charger. If not, we suggest replacing them with new DP cables.

additional_info.subject: 0385124 - ID0385124-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / PD 170001300]  HMI black screen issue CRM:00568000115
additional_info.body:
Bonjour,
Suite au retour de ce jour de M.Borbeau de la société P&G et de la preanalyse du défaut d'écran noir, l'écran est visiblement bien alimenté en 24V au niveau du connecteur vert 3 voies ou se situe l'alimentation, les câbles display sont en place coté PLC et écran, la protection FC14 n'est pas déclenchée, les LED situées dans les petits orifices du capot du display contrôleur sont éteints .
Par conséquent, Je préconise le remplacement de l'écran pour résoudre le problème .
